title: When Trust Attracts Fraud: AI and Trust Arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:2609.27404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trust can attract fraud when it delays verification. We develop a two-market signaling model in which generative AI lowers fabrication, verification, and targeting costs. When fabrication becomes profitable before verification, claim credibility first falls and later recovers. Across markets, higher prior quality can delay verification, creating an interval in which only the lower-quality market checks. If targeting becomes profitable in this interval, deceptive sellers enter the higher-quality but less vigilant market, and their entry can initially reverse its reliability advantage. The inflow also triggers verification and deters further entry. We call this self-limiting mechanism trust arbitrage. In the age of generative AI, trust can thus create an endogenous but temporary protection gap that redirects deception across markets.

translated_title: 当信任吸引欺诈：AI与信任套利
translated_abstract: 当信任延迟了验证时，它反而会吸引欺诈。我们构建了一个双市场信号传递模型，其中生成式AI降低了造假、验证和定向的成本。当造假先于验证变得有利可图时，声明的可信度首先下降，随后回升。在不同市场之间，较高的先验质量可能延迟验证，从而形成一个只有低质量市场进行核查的区间。如果在这一区间内定向变得有利可图，欺诈性卖家便会进入质量更高但警惕性更低的市场，其进入起初可能逆转该市场的可靠性优势。而这种流入也会触发验证并阻止进一步进入。我们将这种自我限制机制称为“信任套利”。在生成式AI时代，信任因此可能造成一种内生的但暂时性的保护缺口，将欺诈行为在市场之间进行转移。
tldr: 该论文构建双市场信号模型，揭示生成式AI催生“信任套利”机制：高信誉市场因信任而延迟验证，反而暂时成为欺诈者的首选目标，但欺诈的流入会自我触发验证并抑制后续进入，形成内生但暂时的保护缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a two-market signaling model revealing a "trust arbitrage" mechanism, in which generative AI causes high-reputation markets to delay verification and temporarily become preferred targets for fraudsters, while the resulting inflow of deception self-triggers verification and limits further entry, creating an endogenous but temporary protection gap.
